description: Use this when someone wants to talk to a person out loud, hear their voice or call them: "can I call Einstein", "I want to hear Marcus Aurelius say it", "let me talk to Cleopatra out loud". Returns a call card. Where the assistant lets the card use the microphone, the call runs right in the card; elsewhere its button opens a live voice call with that person on AI Anyone, in the browser. They pick up when you call. Calling asks the person to sign in to AI Anyone.

mind_id.description: The person id, for example "albert-einstein". Use find_someone_to_ask if unsure.

name: call_person
